column1: # Which look-dev capture families a source change can affect (CTest labels lookdev-*; see test_lookdev_capture.cmake).
# A lane selects: ctest -L '^(<family>|<family>)$' -L '^gpu$' for every row whose prefix matches a path of `git diff --name-only`.
# A changed path matching no row, or the row "*", means the whole look-dev set (the shared renderer: any family can change).
# Keep rows narrow: a prefix names the sources only those families exercise. Maintained by hand until the selector
# is generated from the capture process's loaded shader and library closure (not built; see reports/cl-lookdevfast1.md).
